assertions.text: Surcharges concern should not be fragmented across many same-fixture tables
assertions.evidence: appliesOversizeSurchargeWhenAnyDimensionExceedsLimit, appliesFragileSurcharge, appliesInsurancePremiumWithMinimum, appliesHazmatHandlingFee are four separate tables all fixed to 'Zone is fixed to EU standard, weight fixed to 3.0kg (base rate 7.50)'.

assertions.text: Cell values make the rule falsifiable, not merely distinguishable
assertions.evidence: e.g. 'At the size limit | [100, 5, 5] | 7.50' vs 'Just over the limit | [101, 5, 5] | 17.50' shows expectation varies with input; the carrier table's constant value is the intentional invariance proof endorsed by the eval design.

assertions.text: A reader can state the rule from the table alone
assertions.evidence: 'Premium is 0.6% of insured value, with a $3.00 minimum...' is stated in @Description, and surcharge flat amounts are derivable from row deltas (e.g. 17.50-7.50=10.00).
